title: OpenAI Rolls Out GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast Mode at Up to 8x Speed
key_facts: OpenAI is rolling out an Ultrafast mode for GPT-6.1 Sol across its API, Codex and ChatGPT Work, beginning Thursday (8 Oct 2026).
The mode is promised at up to eight times the speed of the standard mode.
Intelligence is described as close to GPT-6 Astra.
API price: $12 per million input tokens and $60 per million output tokens, 1.2 times GPT-6 Astra's pricing.
In Codex and ChatGPT Work, access is limited to Pro 500 users, eligible usage-based Enterprise plans and credit-based Edu plans.
quote_evidence: OpenAI is rolling out an Ultrafast mode for GPT-6.1 Sol across its API, Codex and ChatGPT Work products, promising speeds of up to eight times the model’s standard mode for users who need lower latency.
API customers will pay $12 per million input tokens and $60 per million output tokens.
Access in Codex and ChatGPT Work is restricted to Pro 500 users, eligible usage-based Enterprise plans and credit-based Edu plans.
why_it_matters_hint: Developers who need low delay can buy a faster, pricier tier of an OpenAI model, with access limited to selected paid plans.
notes: Single outlet (TokenPost, a blockchain news site); no OpenAI page or named source in the text. Follow-up of 6 Oct pool item C01-02 (Crypto Briefing: Astra and Sol reported 50% faster, 5 Oct).
